owner: xlog baseline — mainstream shorts conventions + pilot creator references (LoL gameplay commentary, live-action narrative, movie-clip recut, family vlog comedy)

criteria.name: hook_strength
criteria.description: First 1–2 caption lines declare the situation or throw a hook. A prettier 0s frame loses to a clear premise.

criteria.name: mainstream_convention
criteria.description: Reaction captions on this footage. Source burned-in subtitles must be removed or cut around — cropped source text is a hard fail.

criteria.name: instruction_fit
criteria.description: Faithfully realizes the user's free-form request (caption tone, effects, mood). Ignore this criterion (redistribute judgment) when no request was given.

criteria.name: pacing
criteria.description: Connected scenes beat tighter isolated cuts. Never three process/explanation shots in a row.

criteria.name: narrative_clarity
criteria.description: One premise, stated early, paid back at the end. Looping the same clips while captions carry the story is a fail. One thread only.

criteria.name: moment_selection
criteria.description: Best raw moments, enough visual variety to support the caption story. Do not repeat footage.

preferences: 첫 1–2줄에 지금 상황을 선언하거나 화두를 던져라. 예쁜 오프닝보다 전제가 이긴다.
자막은 그 컷의 대사·어긋남·반응만. 원본에 박힌 자막은 제거하거나 그 구간을 잘라라.
같은 컷을 반복하지 마라. 자막만 돌리고 영상이 없으면 실패다. 한 전제 → 진행 → 회수.
타이트한 컷보다 장면이 이어지는 편집이 이긴다. 과정 설명 샷을 세 개 잇지 마라.
웃기게 ≠ 욕 ≠ 밈 체크리스트. 그 장면에서 벌어진 일만. 템플릿(실화냐, 이게 내 인생, 존나 쎄네)은 실패다.
영상의 킬포인트를 정확히 포착하고 훅을 더 강하게 강조하라.
notes: v13 — judge disagreed: hook_strength and moment_selection were over-weighted relative to raw kill-point impact; nudged weights by ±1 and added the user's kill-point hook preference.
